text:
anya: Quick heads-up: I'm splitting a large docs refactor into 4 small PRs to move /docs/reference/* -> /docs/api-rest/* and fix broken anchors. Need reviewers, redirect plan, and CI gating.

rob: Can you list the PR numbers and which one contains redirects?

anya: Sure: PR 5010 (site index rename), 5011 (auth + examples), 5012 (runtime endpoints), 5013 (redirects + anchor-map). 5013 has redirects. Previews available in PRs.

mila: Merge order suggestion: 5010 -> 5013 -> 5011/5012. Index first so relative links update, redirects next so bookmarks land, then content fixes.

rob: Agreed. Who's owning the redirects PR? We need server-side rewrites and a client anchor alias shim for tricky anchors. Also add smoke tests.

mila: I'll own 5013. Plan: Netlify _redirects + small JS alias map for anchors. Example redirect: /docs/reference/* /docs/api-rest/:splat 301!

ci-bot: Build 5010 docs-preview failed: linkinator reported 9 broken anchors (see logs: https://ci.redwood.example.com/5010/logs).

anya: I'll run local linkinator sweep and push anchor stub fixes to 5013. We should make link-check a required gate for merges. Proposal: require docs-preview + linkcheck:passed label + 2 approvals.

rob: Fine. Add a checklist to each PR description: preview link, linkcheck status, redirects present (if applicable), smoke test results. That makes it easy for release leads to gate.

mila: For anchor aliasing I'll add a small mapping file in 5013 and a runtime redirect snippet: const map = { '#old-anchor': '#new-anchor' }; if (map[location.hash]) location.replace(map[location.hash]);

search-bot: Note: please delay search reindex until redirects are live. Use POST /internal/search/reindex with path /docs/api-rest when ready.

rob: Timeline: can we window merges Wed 09:00 PT? I'll take 09:00-10:00 for 5010+5013 and 10:00-11:00 for content merges. We'll monitor GA and search.

anya: I'll add migration note at top of index and an SDK snippet update in 5011: python example to update base_url.

mila: Smoke tests I'll include in 5013: curl checks for redirects and a small node script that asserts anchor aliasing works against previews.

ci-bot: Reminder: protected branch requires 2 approvals + passing required checks. Any merge without docs-preview green will be reverted.

rob: Assign reviewers: I'll review 5010, mila review 5011, anya review 5012, rob+mila sign off 5013 after smoke tests.

anya: Sounds good. I'll push the anchor corrections to 5013 today and tag reviewers.

mila: I'll add analytics ping on redirect hits (non-blocking) so we can measure legacy traffic. Keep it small: event docs_redirect with old_path.

rob: OK. After 5013 merges, we'll trigger search-bot to reindex and then run a quick crawl to ensure no broken anchors. If we see >5% 404s in the first hour, roll back.

doc-bot: Deploy previews updated for PRs. Diff snapshots attached to PR comments.

anya: Thanks team. I'll open the launch checklist and post the merge window in #release-war-room.

(ends)
